name: sightglass
description: Application observability for developers who don't want an observability stack.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sightglass/core && npm run build -w @sightglass/express && npm run build -w @sightglass/fastify && npm run build -w @sightglass/nest && npm run build -w @sightglass/next && npm run build -w @sightglass/prisma && npm run build -w @sightglass/dashboard && npm run build -w @sightglass/server
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run pack:sdk && npm run verify:recovery
